title: Parameterized JUnit tests
summary: Run the same check for several inputs with an argument source.

richText: Run one test with several inputs
@ParameterizedTest runs the same test method once for each supplied argument set.
An argument source supplies those inputs.
Use @ValueSource for a single value per invocation.
Use @CsvSource for short rows containing several simple values.

example.title: Check several title values with CSV rows
description: The title rule accepts visible text and rejects blank text.
explanation: Each CSV row supplies title and expected to one test invocation.
Morning should be accepted. Three spaces and an empty string should be rejected.
assertEquals compares the expected boolean with the rule’s actual result.
The quoted empty value is an empty string. An unquoted empty CSV value is treated as null.

richText: The provider returns a stream of Arguments. Each Arguments object supplies one argument set.
Use a provider for structured inputs or reusable datasets that are awkward to put in CSV.
Return fresh mutable objects if a test changes its inputs.

example.title: Supply null, empty and whitespace titles
description: This alternative uses a Java argument provider for rejected title inputs.
Use it in a separate example file from the preceding TitleRulesTest.
explanation: The provider produces three invocations: null, an empty string and one space.
The Object cast passes null as one argument rather than as a null argument array.
The assertion checks that none of these inputs is valid.
